title: Practice 1: Prefixes on verbs of motion

blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Трамвай остановился, и девушка **во**шла. (The tram stopped and the girl entered.) What does во- add here?
options: Movement inwards across a threshold, entering
Movement behind an object; stopping off on the way
Intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion
Reaching a limit or destination
exercises.why: The English Wikipedia's table of prefixed motion verbs: в-, во- — Movement inwards across a threshold, entering.

exercises.q: Она **вы**шла из кабинета. (She exited the office.) What does вы- add here?
options: Prolonged multidirectional movement
Movement across, through, or past something
Movement out of something across a threshold, exiting
Approach
exercises.why: The English Wikipedia's table of prefixed motion verbs: вы- — Movement out of something across a threshold, exiting.

exercises.q: Он **при**ехал в Москву неделю назад. (He arrived in Moscow a week ago.) What does при- add here?
options: Beginning of multidirectional movement
Movement downwards
Intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion
Slow and measured multidirectional movement
exercises.why: The English Wikipedia's table of prefixed motion verbs: при- — Intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion.

exercises.q: Они **у**летят из Владивостока через месяц. (They will leave Vladivostok in a month.) What does у- add here?
options: Withdrawal a short distance away
Reaching a limit or destination
Intended departure, signals absence
Movement across, through, or past something
exercises.why: The English Wikipedia's table of prefixed motion verbs: у- — Intended departure, signals absence.

exercises.q: Он **подо**шёл к девушке, чтобы спросить её номер. (He approached the girl to ask for her number.) What does подо- add here?
options: Withdrawal a short distance away
Movement downwards
Divergent movement in various directions from one center
Approach
exercises.why: The English Wikipedia's table of prefixed motion verbs: под-, подо- — Approach.

exercises.q: Мальчик **ото**шёл от незнакомца, который предложил ему конфеты. (The boy stepped back from the stranger who had offered him candy.) What does ото- add here?
options: Beginning of unidirectional movement
Withdrawal a short distance away
Movement out of something across a threshold, exiting
Prolonged multidirectional movement
exercises.why: The English Wikipedia's table of prefixed motion verbs: от-, ото- — Withdrawal a short distance away.

exercises.q: Пассажиры **до**ехали до последней остановки и вышли из автобуса. (The passengers reached the last station and exited the bus.) What does до- add here?
options: Prolonged multidirectional movement
Movement downwards
Movement behind an object; stopping off on the way
Reaching a limit or destination
exercises.why: The English Wikipedia's table of prefixed motion verbs: до- — Reaching a limit or destination.

exercises.q: Старушка **за**шла за угол и исчезла. (The old woman walked behind the corner and disappeared.) What does за- add here?
options: Movement across, through, or past something
Divergent movement in various directions from one center
Movement behind an object; stopping off on the way
Withdrawal a short distance away
exercises.why: The English Wikipedia's table of prefixed motion verbs: за- — Movement behind an object; stopping off on the way.

exercises.q: Мы **про**ехали через город. (We drove through the city.) What does про- add here?
options: Intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion
Movement out of something across a threshold, exiting
Movement across, through, or past something
Movement inwards across a threshold, entering
exercises.why: The English Wikipedia's table of prefixed motion verbs: про- — Movement across, through, or past something.

exercises.q: Утки **пере**плыли реку. (The ducks swam across the river.) What does пере- add here?
options: Movement inwards across a threshold, entering
Movement onto the surface of an object
Reaching a limit or destination
Movement across, from one point to another; through
exercises.why: The English Wikipedia's table of prefixed motion verbs: пере- — Movement across, from one point to another; through.

exercises.q: Альпинист **взо**шёл на гору. (The mountain climber walked up the mountain.) What does взо- add here?
options: Intended departure, signals absence
Movement around an object or involving a consecutive number of objects, circling, covering a whole place
Movement upwards
Completed semelfactive movement in opposite directions, there and back.
exercises.why: The English Wikipedia's table of prefixed motion verbs: вз-, взо-, воз-, вс-, вос- — Movement upwards.

exercises.q: После представления актёр **со**шёл со сцены. (After the performance, the actor got off the stage.) What does со- add here?
options: Movement across, from one point to another; through
Movement downwards
Movement around an object or involving a consecutive number of objects, circling, covering a whole place
Movement inwards across a threshold, entering
exercises.why: The English Wikipedia's table of prefixed motion verbs: с-, со- — Movement downwards.
